uncertain.why: Second verse line («في كـِل لمحةٍ وَ»). The only mark on «كـل» is one kasra. It is centred under the short kashida between ك and ل (page x 0.650-0.659, the flat stroke spans 0.646-0.660). It sits about 0.013 of the page height below that stroke, lower than the bottom of the ل bowl. So it may have been typed after ك (كِل) or on ل (كلِ). Checked with a 1800 dpi render and connected-component measurements. There is no shadda and no damma. Best reading: كِل.

print_errors.note: Printed with hamza ABOVE the alif (الأ), checked at 1200 dpi. The expected spelling is الإدريسي. Kept as printed.
A closing ] is printed after «مرة)» with no matching [ in this paragraph. The [ before «اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ» in the previous paragraph is already closed after «وَسَلِّمْ]». Kept as printed.

Third verse line. The ع of وَسِعهُ has no fatha, and the ل of عِلمُ has no sukun, although the neighbouring letters are vowelled. A slanted stroke between verse lines 2 and 3 looks like a fatha over ع in the crops. Component analysis places it at x 0.650-0.659, y 0.769-0.774. That is the kasra of «كـِل» from the line above, not a mark of وسعه. Kept as printed.
The ع carries a clear sukun (ring-shaped sukun, checked at 2000 dpi), not a fatha. Kept as printed.

notes: Markers: all four pages continue a sentence broken by the page turn, so all four are marked +. p076 ends «(سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ،» and p077 begins «أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ…». p077 ends «…مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ» and p078 begins «اللهِ ﷺ)…». p078 ends «…الْحَاجَاتِ * يَا» and p079 begins «حَاضِرًا…». p079 ends «…وَهُوَ حَسْبُنَا» and p080 begins «وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ…». There are no footnotes on pp.076-080, so there is no (تابع). There are no headings and no ** or == markup. The heavy محمد is the font's ligature, as in keyB b19. p077 verse block: the three bold centred lines are set in one heavier font. Lines 1-2 are printed in two halves with a gap and go in :::شعر with ***. Line 3 («وَسِعهُ عِلمُ الله [مائة مرة]») is a single centred line and goes in :::شعر مشطور. The block is all bold, so no **. Tatweel in these lines and in «فاعْلَـمْ أَنَّـــهُ… اللـه… مُحَـمَّـدٌ رَسُـــولُ» was dropped. «في» in verse line 2 has no kasra (component check). p077 «(فاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ ) ( لَا إِلَهَ…»: the spaces inside the brackets are printed clearly, wider than a normal word space at 1000 dpi, so they were kept. p078 first word: the slanted stroke between lines 1 and 2 is a deep kasra under the Allah ligature, so the text is «اللهِ ﷺ». Its offset from the ligature body (top 0.0138 below the body, left edge 0.0015 left of it, width 0.0087) matches the printed «بِاللهِ» on p079 exactly. The fatha of ثَبِّتْنَا is a separate component above ث. Every other bare «الله» on these pages was checked for such a deep kasra and for an upper case vowel, with none found: p077 lines 2, 11, 12 and both verse lines, and p079 «(صلواتُ الله». «اللهُ،» (p077, last line) and «بِاللهِ» (p079) carry printed vowels. ﷺ on p078 is kept as U+FDFA. Lam-alif marks are on the upright right-hand stroke (the lam) in every case, as in keyB b13/b19. So the text has لَا / إِلَّا / مَوْلَانَا, and the sukun of الْأُمِّيِّ، الْأَبْرَارِ، الْأَسْرَارِ is on the lam. «عَالِمَ» (p078, twice): the kasra is under ل and the fatha is above the tail of م (2200 dpi). Spelling kept as printed: «وَكُن لَّنَا» (no sukun on ن, shadda on ل); «قَرِيب» with no final vowel; «ربَّ العالمين» with shadda+fatha only in some «آمين» lines and bare «رب» in others, each line checked; «آمين» always has madda. p079 «].آمين» is printed with no space and was written «]. آمين», following the keyB one-space normalisation. «(ثلاثًا)» never has a fatha on the first ث on these pages. Paragraphs follow the printed indents. A non-indented «[تقرأ مرة واحدة للمتعجل]» after a full line is a wrap of the same paragraph, as on p078. Quran: 37:180-182 (p077 and p080), the whole of al-Fatiha with the basmala printed inside the brackets as ayah (١) in the mushaf font, and 33:56. scripts/quran.py reports no difference from Tanzil. Encodings: round zero U+06DF on ءَامَنُوا۟، صَلُّوا۟، وَسَلِّمُوا۟ (closed oval rings, distinct from the open sukun of عَلَيْهِ and تَسْلِيمًا, 2000-2400 dpi); dotless final ى in ٱلنَّبِىِّ (no dots under the final ya, 2000 dpi); waqf ۚ after ٱلنَّبِىِّ; وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ with dagger alif + madda and small waw. References: [الصافات: ١٨٠-١٨٢] (p077; letter-spaced on its own line on p080), [الفاتحة: ١-٧], [الأحزاب: ٥٦], all with Arabic-Indic digits in logical order. Zoom images: scratch\b20B_*.png.
